title: The Magic Garden Adventure
text: A young girl with bright eyes discovers a hidden garden behind her house. She finds a small injured bird with colorful feathers lying on the ground. The girl gently picks up the bird and takes it to a safe place. She gives the bird some water and seeds to help it recover. The bird slowly opens its eyes and chirps happily at the kind girl. Together they explore the magical flowers that glow in the sunlight. The bird shows the girl a secret path through the garden maze. They become best friends and play together every sunny afternoon.

quiz.question: What did the girl find in the garden?
